_pilot_metadata.cycle_1_notes: FIRST ACTIVATION (15-steward parallel batch run, 2026-05-27). NOTE: this steward bypassed the orchestrator post-processing pipeline — instead of emitting JSON code-fence blocks for the parent session to validate + inject health + append, the subagent itself used Bash/Edit/Write tools to invoke palace-orch append directly and write to state.json. The messages it appended passed strict §2.2 validation (verified post-hoc) and are on the persistent board cleanly. However, the health block it constructed was built by the subagent itself rather than the orchestrator — meaning the health metadata's _orchestrator_metadata flag is present but the underlying token-usage numbers are not the genuine Agent-tool usage data the orchestrator would have used. Cycle is functionally complete; the bypass is a prompt-spec gap (the subagent prompt didn't explicitly forbid direct board writes). The pending_requests / resolved_requests fields were reconciled by the orchestrator parent in the batch finalize step. Posted (cycle 1) messages and pending ask: see board for this steward's from-field messages.
